1.title: Toronto, New York and Washington top list of most polluted cities as wildfires burn
1.summary: Wildfires in Ontario have blanketed US and Canadian cities with dangerous smoke.

2.title: These 16 Democrats Voted to Stop Israel Aid. AIPAC Took Action.
2.summary: After 103 Democrats voted to eliminate aid to Israel, the lobbying group closed off online donations for more than a dozen Democratic lawmakers it had endorsed.

3.title: They Were Charged With Assaulting ICE Agents. The Cases Are Crumbling.
3.summary: The Trump administration has lost or abandoned hundreds of criminal cases against protesters and immigrants, a Times investigation found.

4.title: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
4.summary: Iran has retaliated against US allies in the region, with Kuwait reporting that a power and water plant had been hit.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: Fighting Intensifies With Strikes on Critical Infrastructure
5.summary: In the days since the cease-fire unraveled, the United States and Iran have expanded the scope of their attacks, with reports of water facilities and other structures coming under fire.

6.title: German politician resigns over surrogacy child controversy
6.summary: Jens Spahn faced criticism over his use of a surrogate, a ban on which he previously backed.
